subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They asked who benefited from the road and who paid the cost.”?
options: The teacher said photos can support different stories depending on the caption.
People posted photos, stories, and messages from different years.
Their teacher said the accident was not serious, but it was useful.
The teacher gave him another sheet and said, "Slow hands can still learn."

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They asked who benefited from the road and who paid the cost. The teacher said photos can support different stories depending on…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People posted photos, stories, and messages from different years.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Their teacher said the accident was not serious, but it was useful.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher gave him another sheet and said, 'Slow hands can still learn.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They asked who benefited from the road and who paid the cost. The teacher said photos can support different stories depending on the caption.」，答案為「The teacher said photos can support different stories depending on the caption.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The teacher said photos can support different stories depending on the caption.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
